summary_1line: Yudhishthira questions how the virtuous, Vishnu‑devoted Asura Vritra was defeated by Indra, prompting Bhishma to begin recounting their colossal battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra on his celestial chariot confronts the colossal Asura Vritra towering like a mountain, five hundred yojanas high.
The sky fills with flying weapons, blazing fires, rocks, and arrows as gods and asuras clash while sages and celestial beings watch from radiant chariots.
Vritra darkens the heavens by hurling a massive storm of rocks toward Indra and the assembled gods.
